identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Evaluating The Effects Of Neratinib After Adjuvant Trastuzumab In Women With Early Stage Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial Of Neratinib (HKI-272) After Trastuzumab In Women With Early-Stage HER-2/Neu Overexpressed/Amplified Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to investigate whether neratinib can further reduce the risk of recurrence from previously diagnosed HER-2 positive breast cancer after adjuvant treatment with trastuzumab.

armGroups.label: Neratinib
armGroups.description: 240 mg orally daily for one year

primaryOutcomes.measure: Invasive Disease-free Survival (iDFS) in Neratinib Arm Compared to Placebo Arm at Year 2
primaryOutcomes.description: Invasive disease-free survival time is defined as the time from date of randomization until the first disease recurrence of the following events: invasive ipsilateral breast tumor recurrence, invasive contralateral breast cancer, local/regional invasive recurrence, distant recurrence and death from any cause.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

primaryOutcomes.measure: Kaplan-Meier Estimates of Invasive Disease-free Survival (iDFS) at Year 2 by Treatment Arms
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS was defined as the time from randomization to death due to any cause, censored at the last date known alive.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Randomization until death due to any cause (up to 119 Months)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease-free Survival Including Ductal Carcinoma in Situ (DFS-DCIS) in Neratinib Arm Compared to Placebo Arm at Year 2
secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease-free survival including DCIS time is defined as the time from date of randomization until the first occurrence of DCIS or an iDFS event (an iDFS event including invasive ipsilateral breast tumor recurrence, invasive contralateral breast cancer, local/regional invasive recurrence, or distant recurrence and death from any.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Kaplan-Meier Estimates of Disease-free Survival Including Ductal Carcinoma in Situ (DFS-DCIS) at Year 2 by Treatment Arms
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Distant Disease-free Survival (DDFS) in Neratinib Arm Compared to Placebo Arm at Year 2
secondaryOutcomes.description: Distant disease-free survival time is defined as the time from date of randomization until the first occurrence of distant recurrence or death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Kaplan-Meier Estimates of Distant Disease-free Survival (DDFS) at Year 2 by Treatment Arms
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Time to Distant Recurrence (TTDR) Event in Neratinib Arm Compared to Placebo Arm at Year 2
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of Participants with TTDR events is reported. TTDR is defined as the time from date of randomization until the first occurrence of distant recurrence or death from breast cancer.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Kaplan-Meier Estimates of Time to Distant Recurrence (TTDR) Survival at Year 2 by Treatment Arms
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Central Nervous System Recurrence in Neratinib Arm Compared to Placebo Arm at Year 2
secondaryOutcomes.description: CNS recurrence is defined as the time from randomization to CNS as the first distant recurrence. Competing events include distant recurrence at other sites as the first distant recurrence and death from any cause prior to distant recurrence.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Cumulative Incidence of Central Nervous System Recurrence (CNS) at Year 2
secondaryOutcomes.description: Cumulative incidence of Central Nervous System Recurrence (CNS) is estimated by Gray's method (Gray,1988).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization until time of event up to 2 years

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage II through IIIC HER-2/erbB-2 positive breast cancer with node positive disease.
* Been treated for early breast cancer with standard of care duration of trastuzumab.
* Could have been treated neoadjuvantly but have not reached pathologic complete response.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Positive clinical and radiologic assessments for local or regional recurrence of disease at the time of study entry.
* History of heart disease.
* Corrected QT (QTc) interval \>0.45 seconds
* History of gastrointestinal disease with diarrhea as the major symptom.
